Select IC50 activities for human amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B (CHEMBL2039). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2039 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
